avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction increases sumatriptan metabolism; serotonergic activity increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort at least 2 weeks before sumatriptan use or switch to alternative antidepressant

avoid_supplements.name: 5-Hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct serotonergic precursor increases risk of serotonin syndrome when combined with 5-HT1 agonist
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; maintain minimum 24-hour separation between doses

avoid_supplements.name: L-Tryptophan
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonin precursor increases central serotonergic tone, elevating serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation during sumatriptan therapy; consider alternative amino acid source

avoid_supplements.name: SAMe (S-Adenosyl Methionine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonergic activity may potentiate serotonin syndrome risk in combination with triptans
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; select alternative mood support if needed

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild serotonergic effects and theoretical CYP3A4 interaction; additive stimulant properties possible
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive stimulation, tremor, or palpitations; use lowest effective dose

caution_supplements.name: Feverfew
caution_supplements.mechanism: Used for migraine prevention; potential additive vasoconstrictive effects at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Coordinate migraine management strategy; monitor blood pressure and heart rate

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium
caution_supplements.mechanism: Migraine prophylaxis supplement; no direct interaction but therapeutic overlap in migraine management
caution_supplements.action: May enhance therapeutic benefit; ensure adequate but not excessive supplementation (>400 mg/day)

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (cured meats, aged cheeses, fermented products)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Tyramine can trigger hypertensive crisis; combined with sumatriptan's vasoconstrictive properties increases cardiovascular risk
avoid_foods.action: Limit intake of cured bacon, aged cheddar, blue cheese, soy sauce, sauerkraut, and fermented soy products

caution_foods.name: High-caffeine foods and beverages (coffee, energy drinks, chocolate)
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine is often used adjunctively in migraine therapy but excess may increase stimulant effects and cardiovascular stress
caution_foods.action: Limit to <200 mg caffeine on sumatriptan dosing days; monitor for tremor or tachycardia

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: May potentiate vasodilation countereffects and increase migraine recurrence; mild CNS depression interaction
caution_foods.action: Minimize alcohol consumption on treatment days; avoid heavy use during migraine episode

monitoring_notes: Primary concern is serotonin syndrome risk with concurrent serotonergic agents (SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs, herbal serotonergics); monitor for agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity, and hyperthermia. Sumatriptan's vasoconstrictive properties warrant caution with foods/supplements affecting vascular tone and blood pressure, particularly in patients with cardiovascular risk factors.
